name: QuickBooks Time
summary: QuickBooks Time charges a monthly base fee plus a fee per user: $20 plus $10 per user on Time Premium and $40 plus $12 on Time Elite. It requires a QuickBooks Online subscription, bills monthly, and includes timesheet approval on both plans.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: Intuit raised the per-user price of Time Premium and Time Elite by $2 a month from July 1, 2026, and left the base fee unchanged.
A QuickBooks Online account is required to use QuickBooks Time.
Geofencing is available on Time Elite only, not on Time Premium.
Admins can require location tracking while people are on the clock, and Intuit states that admins cannot see location data when workers are off the clock.
The Workforce plans, which add payroll, can be used only in the United States.

plans.name: Time Premium
plans.notes: Plus a $20 monthly base fee that includes 1 admin, discounted to $10 for the first 3 months

plans.name: Time Elite
plans.notes: Plus a $40 monthly base fee that includes 1 admin, discounted to $20 for the first 3 months. Adds geofencing

plans.name: Workforce Premium
plans.notes: Plus an $88 monthly base fee, discounted to $44 for the first 3 months. Adds payroll, US only

plans.name: Workforce Elite
plans.notes: Plus a $134 monthly base fee, discounted to $67 for the first 3 months. Adds HR and benefits, US only

hiddenCosts: A QuickBooks Online subscription is required and priced separately.
Every plan has a monthly base fee on top of the per-user price.
The 30-day trial and the introductory discount apply to the base fee only, not to per-user fees.

contract.cancellation: Cancellation takes effect the day after the current monthly period ends, with no refunds or credits for partial periods.
contract.dataExport: Timesheets as CSV and reports as PDF, with API access as an add-on.
